text:
incident-bot: AUTOSCALER ALERT — eu-gpu-pool queue growth > 3x baseline for 6m, throttling observed, paging oncall
Maya (oncall): seeing 429s from hosted API, lots of queued requests in the autoscale queue. digging into metrics now :eyes:
Maya (oncall): attaching queue graph: link_to_dashboards/queue?range=15m
Sandeep: I can join — recent deploy to autoscaler yesterday? any rollouts?
Eli: no rollout flagged in deployment log. autoscaler controller heartbeats look healthy but scaleup attempts failing due to scale-limit errors from provider (quota).
Tom (eng-runtime): provider quota + our scale-limit gating combined. We probably hit reserved capacity cap for the EU region.
Priya (CS): customers DMing about timeouts; one enterprise tenant reported errors on ingestion jobs. I flagged top 3 impacted orgs in the ticket.
Maya (oncall): mitigation proposal: 1) enable spillover routing to dedicated pool (if capacity) 2) evict best-effort tenants 3) request emergency quota bump with provider. any objections?
Sandeep: +1 to spillover. How do we enable quickly?
Tom (eng-runtime): run: 
```
# enable eu spillover routing
curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/v1/regions/eu/actions/spillover -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP" -d '{"target_pool":"dedicated-eu-burst"}'
```
Maya (oncall): running that now...
ops-bot: action:spillover:start triggered by Maya (oncall) at 6260001160
ops-bot: action:spillover:success — routing enabled to dedicated-eu-burst (capacity +120 GPUs)
Eli: seeing queue drop ~40% already, throttles reduced but still some 429s for long-running generation workloads.
Tom (eng-runtime): starting eviction of low-priority tenants: `./tools/evict --pool eu-gpu-pool --priority best-effort`
Sandeep: provider quota request submitted (case 987654) asking for +200 GPUs emergency. ETA unknown.
Priya (CS): messaging to impacted customers: brief update posted to status.redwood.com, letting them know we've enabled spillover and are mitigating.
Maya (oncall): current status: queue growth stabilizing, 95th latency improving, customer errors reduced. keeping this live until quota is confirmed or traffic normalizes.
Eli: quick note — autoscaler has deadlock protection disabled for scale-in windows (we changed it during last tuning). add to action items to revert that and add better alerts for provider quota errors.
Tom (eng-runtime): captured logs and controller traces, filing bug: AUTOSCALE-4219.
Sandeep: taking ownership of follow-up: will coordinate with cloud partner for quota and add a preflight check to fail open to spillover sooner.
Maya (oncall): handing off to Sandeep for follow-through — I'm going offline in 20m. @Sandeep please ack if you take the post-incident tasks.
Sandeep: ack, I'll own the postmortem and follow-ups.
Priya (CS): post-incident comms draft in #marketing-drafts, will sync once root cause clear.
Maya (oncall): quick action items summary: 
- (Sandeep) emergency quota follow-up with provider (case 987654)
- (Tom) AUTOSCALE-4219 bug + revert risky tuning change
- (Eli) add alert for provider-scale-errors and queue-growth SLO
- (Ops) formalize spillover runbook and a one-click control in console
- (Priya) customer comms follow-up
Maya (oncall): closing handoff — Sandeep now primary. Will add timeline and logs to the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
Sandeep: thanks — will run a brief RCA doc and schedule postmortem meeting for tomorrow 09:30 UTC.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTICE — severity reduced to P2 at 6260001400 (stabilized, degradation only).
Maya (oncall): thanks team.
Priya (CS): closing customer loop for the customers I reached out to; no escalations now.
Tom (eng-runtime): moving logs to /incidents/6260001111 and creating initial draft of evacuation/failover playbook changes.
Eli: quick retrospective note — add automated provider-quota-safety-check to CI for infra changes.
Sandeep: will attach postmortem and action items to ticket by EOD.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: postmortem-meeting at 2026-03-18T09:30:00Z
